name: CRM Lead - Get or Create Customer
script:
# Returns the Customer linked to a CRM Lead (Customer.custom_crm_lead), creating it on first use.
# Used by the CRM Lead Create > Quotation / Site Visit buttons.
lead_name = frappe.form_dict.get("lead")
if not lead_name:
    frappe.throw("CRM Lead is required")

lead = frappe.get_doc("CRM Lead", lead_name)
lead.check_permission("read")

existing = frappe.db.get_value("Customer", {"custom_crm_lead": lead.name}, "name")
if existing:
    frappe.response["message"] = {"customer": existing, "created": 0}
else:
    full_name = (lead.lead_name or " ".join([p for p in [lead.first_name, lead.last_name] if p]) or "").strip()
    cust = frappe.new_doc("Customer")
    cust.customer_name = full_name or lead.name
    cust.customer_type = "Individual"
    cust.custom_crm_lead = lead.name

    mobile = "".join([ch for ch in (lead.mobile_no or "") if ch.isdigit() or ch == "+"])
    if mobile:
        cust.mobile_no = mobile
    if lead.email:
        cust.email_id = lead.email

    place = lead.custom_location or lead.custom_district
    if place:
        cust.address_line1 = place
        cust.city = lead.custom_location or lead.custom_district
        cust.state = "Kerala"
        cust.country = "India"

    cust.insert()
    frappe.response["message"] = {"customer": cust.name, "created": 1}

script:
oc_name = frappe.form_dict.get("name")
if not oc_name:
    frappe.throw("Order Confirmation is required")
oc = frappe.get_doc("Order Confirmation", oc_name)
oc.check_permission("read")
amount = frappe.utils.flt(oc.advance_amount)
if amount <= 0:
    frappe.throw("Please enter the Advance Amount first.")
if not oc.customer:
    frappe.throw("This Order Confirmation has no Customer.")

linked = False
company = None
if oc.sales_order:
    so = frappe.db.get_value("Sales Order", oc.sales_order, ["docstatus", "company"], as_dict=True)
    if so:
        linked = so.docstatus == 1
        company = so.company
if not company:
    company = frappe.db.get_single_value("Global Defaults", "default_company")

posting_date = oc.advance_date or frappe.utils.today()

if linked:
    pe = frappe.call("erpnext.accounts.doctype.payment_entry.payment_entry.get_payment_entry", dt="Sales Order", dn=oc.sales_order, party_amount=amount)
else:
    currency = frappe.db.get_value("Company", company, "default_currency")
    party_account = frappe.call("erpnext.accounts.party.get_party_account", party_type="Customer", party=oc.customer, company=company)
    pe = frappe.new_doc("Payment Entry")
    pe.payment_type = "Receive"
    pe.company = company
    pe.party_type = "Customer"
    pe.party = oc.customer
    pe.party_name = frappe.db.get_value("Customer", oc.customer, "customer_name")
    pe.paid_from = party_account
    pe.paid_from_account_currency = frappe.db.get_value("Account", party_account, "account_currency") or currency
    pe.paid_amount = amount
    pe.received_amount = amount
    pe.source_exchange_rate = 1
    pe.target_exchange_rate = 1
    pe.base_paid_amount = amount
    pe.base_received_amount = amount
    pe.unallocated_amount = amount

pe.posting_date = posting_date
pe.reference_date = posting_date
if oc.mode_of_payment:
    pe.mode_of_payment = oc.mode_of_payment
    acc = frappe.call("erpnext.accounts.doctype.sales_invoice.sales_invoice.get_bank_cash_account", mode_of_payment=oc.mode_of_payment, company=company)
    if acc and acc.get("account"):
        pe.paid_to = acc.get("account")
        pe.paid_to_account_currency = frappe.db.get_value("Account", pe.paid_to, "account_currency")
pe.custom_remarks = 1
pe.remarks = f"Advance received against Order Confirmation {oc.name}"
pe.custom_order_confirmation = oc.name

frappe.response["message"] = {"doc": pe.as_dict(), "linked": linked}

# Quotation.custom_order_confirmation points back at this Order Confirmation, which would block
# the delete (circular link). Clear it so the OC can be deleted and the Quotation becomes
# confirmable / cancellable again.
for qn in frappe.get_all("Quotation", filters={"custom_order_confirmation": doc.name}, pluck="name"):
    frappe.db.set_value("Quotation", qn, {"custom_order_confirmed": 0, "custom_order_confirmation": None}, update_modified=False)
    frappe.get_doc("Quotation", qn).add_comment("Comment", f"Order Confirmation {doc.name} deleted; quotation unlinked.")

Quotation - Order Confirm
script:
# Confirms a submitted Quotation: converts a CRM Lead party into a Customer (only here, at order
# confirmation), creates a draft Sales Order from it (ERPNext's own mapper), creates an Order
# Confirmation record, and flags the Quotation as Order Confirmed.
qname = frappe.form_dict.get("quotation")
delivery_date = frappe.form_dict.get("delivery_date") or frappe.utils.today()
agreed = frappe.utils.flt(frappe.form_dict.get("agreed_amount"))
confirmed = frappe.utils.flt(frappe.form_dict.get("confirmed_amount"))

if not qname:
    frappe.throw("Quotation is required")

q = frappe.get_doc("Quotation", qname)
q.check_permission("read")
if q.docstatus != 1:
    frappe.throw("Please submit the Quotation before confirming the order.")
if q.custom_order_confirmed:
    frappe.throw(f"This quotation is already confirmed ({q.custom_order_confirmation}).")
if q.status == "Lost":
    frappe.throw("This quotation is marked as Lost.")

# ---- CRM Lead -> Customer conversion (happens only on order confirmation) ----
crm_lead = None
customer = None
if q.quotation_to == "CRM Lead":
    crm_lead = q.party_name
    lead = frappe.get_doc("CRM Lead", crm_lead)
    customer = frappe.db.get_value("Customer", {"custom_crm_lead": crm_lead}, "name")
    if not customer:
        full_name = (lead.lead_name or " ".join([p for p in [lead.first_name, lead.last_name] if p]) or "").strip()
        cust = frappe.new_doc("Customer")
        cust.customer_name = full_name or q.customer_name or lead.name
        cust.customer_type = "Individual"
        cust.custom_crm_lead = lead.name
        mobile = "".join([ch for ch in (lead.mobile_no or "") if ch.isdigit() or ch == "+"])
        if mobile:
            cust.mobile_no = mobile
        if lead.email:
            cust.email_id = lead.email
        place = lead.custom_location or lead.custom_district
        if place:
            cust.address_line1 = place
            cust.city = lead.custom_location or lead.custom_district
            cust.state = "Kerala"
            cust.country = "India"
        cust.insert()
        customer = cust.name
    # Point the quotation at the new customer so the standard Sales Order mapper works
    frappe.db.set_value("Quotation", q.name, {"quotation_to": "Customer", "party_name": customer, "customer_name": frappe.db.get_value("Customer", customer, "customer_name")}, update_modified=False)
    # Mark the CRM Lead as converted
    frappe.db.set_value("CRM Lead", crm_lead, {"converted": 1, "status": "Converted"})
    q.add_comment("Comment", f"CRM Lead {crm_lead} converted to Customer {customer} on order confirmation.")
elif q.quotation_to == "Customer":
    customer = q.party_name
    crm_lead = frappe.db.get_value("Customer", customer, "custom_crm_lead")

# Sales Order (draft) via the standard Quotation -> Sales Order mapper
so = frappe.call("erpnext.selling.doctype.quotation.quotation.make_sales_order", source_name=q.name)
so.delivery_date = delivery_date
for it in so.items:
    it.delivery_date = delivery_date
so.insert()

# Lead owner from the CRM Lead (if any)
lead_owner = None
if crm_lead:
    lead_owner = frappe.db.get_value("CRM Lead", crm_lead, "custom_referred_by")

quotation_amount = q.rounded_total or q.grand_total
oc = frappe.new_doc("Order Confirmation")
oc.quotation = q.name
oc.customer = so.customer
oc.customer_name = so.customer_name or q.customer_name
oc.lead_owner = lead_owner
oc.valid_from = q.transaction_date
oc.valid_till = q.valid_till
oc.quotation_amount = quotation_amount
oc.agreed_amount = agreed or quotation_amount
oc.confirmed_amount = confirmed or oc.agreed_amount
oc.sales_order = so.name
oc.insert()

frappe.db.set_value("Quotation", q.name, {"custom_order_confirmed": 1, "custom_order_confirmation": oc.name}, update_modified=False)
q.add_comment("Comment", f"Order confirmed: {oc.name}, Sales Order {so.name} created.")

frappe.response["message"] = {"order_confirmation": oc.name, "sales_order": so.name, "customer": customer}

script:
# API wa_make_payment: Payment Entry (Employee/Supplier) or payment Journal Entry (Other payees)
# for posted job cost lines of one payee. Returns an unsaved document for the user to review.
name = frappe.form_dict.get("name")
keys = frappe.form_dict.get("keys") or []
if isinstance(keys, str):
    keys = json.loads(keys) if keys else []
mop = frappe.form_dict.get("mode_of_payment")
posting_date = frappe.form_dict.get("posting_date") or frappe.utils.today()
part_amount = frappe.utils.flt(frappe.form_dict.get("amount"))
wa = frappe.get_doc("Work Allocation", name)
wa.check_permission("write")
s = frappe.get_doc("Work Allocation Settings")
roles = frappe.get_all("Has Role", filters={"parent": frappe.session.user, "parenttype": "User"}, pluck="role")
if frappe.session.user == "Administrator":
    roles.append("System Manager")
if not ("System Manager" in roles or "Accounts Manager" in roles or (s.accounts_role and s.accounts_role in roles)):
    frappe.throw("Only Accounts users can make job cost payments.")
if not mop:
    frappe.throw("Select a Mode of Payment.")
sel = []
for c in wa.costs:
    if c.source_key in keys and c.accounting_status == "Posted" and frappe.utils.flt(c.outstanding_amount) > 0.005:
        sel.append(c)
if not sel:
    frappe.throw("Select at least one posted, unpaid cost line.")
ptype = sel[0].party_type
party = sel[0].party or ""
for c in sel:
    if c.party_type != ptype or (c.party or "") != party or (ptype == "Other" and c.payee_name != sel[0].payee_name):
        frappe.throw("Pay one payee at a time: the selected lines are for different payees.")
alloc = {}
total = 0
for c in sel:
    a = frappe.utils.flt(c.outstanding_amount)
    if part_amount and len(sel) == 1:
        if part_amount > a + 0.005:
            frappe.throw(f"Amount can't exceed the outstanding {a}.")
        a = part_amount
    alloc[c.source_key] = a
    total += a
company = wa.company or s.company
cc = wa.cost_center or s.default_cost_center
bank = frappe.call("erpnext.accounts.doctype.sales_invoice.sales_invoice.get_bank_cash_account", mode_of_payment=mop, company=company)
paid_from = bank.get("account") if bank else None
if not paid_from:
    frappe.throw(f"Set the {company} account for Mode of Payment {mop}.")
currency = frappe.db.get_value("Company", company, "default_currency")
remark = f"Job Card {wa.name} ({wa.customer_name or wa.customer}): payment to {sel[0].payee_name}"

if ptype in ["Employee", "Supplier"]:
    payable = s.employee_payable_account if ptype == "Employee" else s.supplier_payable_account
    pe = frappe.new_doc("Payment Entry")
    pe.payment_type = "Pay"
    pe.company = company
    pe.posting_date = posting_date
    pe.mode_of_payment = mop
    pe.party_type = ptype
    pe.party = party
    pe.party_name = sel[0].payee_name
    pe.paid_from = paid_from
    pe.paid_from_account_currency = frappe.db.get_value("Account", paid_from, "account_currency") or currency
    pe.paid_to = payable
    pe.paid_to_account_currency = frappe.db.get_value("Account", payable, "account_currency") or currency
    pe.paid_amount = total
    pe.received_amount = total
    pe.base_paid_amount = total
    pe.base_received_amount = total
    pe.source_exchange_rate = 1
    pe.target_exchange_rate = 1
    pe.reference_date = posting_date
    pe.cost_center = cc
    pe.project = wa.project
    by_je = {}
    for c in sel:
        by_je[c.journal_entry] = by_je.get(c.journal_entry, 0) + alloc[c.source_key]
    for je_name in by_je:
        a = by_je[je_name]
        pe.append("references", {"reference_doctype": "Journal Entry", "reference_name": je_name, "total_amount": a, "outstanding_amount": a, "allocated_amount": a})
    pe.total_allocated_amount = total
    pe.unallocated_amount = 0
    pe.custom_remarks = 1
    pe.remarks = remark
    pe.custom_work_allocation = wa.name
    pe.custom_wa_lines = json.dumps({"costs": alloc})
    frappe.response["message"] = {"doc": pe.as_dict()}
else:
    je = frappe.new_doc("Journal Entry")
    je.voucher_type = "Journal Entry"
    je.company = company
    je.posting_date = posting_date
    je.mode_of_payment = mop
    je.custom_work_allocation = wa.name
    je.custom_wa_purpose = "Payment"
    je.custom_wa_lines = json.dumps(alloc)
    je.user_remark = remark
    je.append("accounts", {"account": s.other_payable_account, "debit_in_account_currency": total, "cost_center": cc, "project": wa.project, "user_remark": remark})
    je.append("accounts", {"account": paid_from, "credit_in_account_currency": total, "cost_center": cc, "project": wa.project, "user_remark": remark})
    frappe.response["message"] = {"doc": je.as_dict()}

name: Work Allocation - Post to Accounts
script:
# API wa_post_to_accounts: draft Journal Entry accruing all approved, unposted job costs
name = frappe.form_dict.get("name")
wa = frappe.get_doc("Work Allocation", name)
wa.check_permission("write")
s = frappe.get_doc("Work Allocation Settings")
roles = frappe.get_all("Has Role", filters={"parent": frappe.session.user, "parenttype": "User"}, pluck="role")
if frappe.session.user == "Administrator":
    roles.append("System Manager")
if not ("System Manager" in roles or "Accounts Manager" in roles or (s.accounts_role and s.accounts_role in roles)):
    frappe.throw("Only Accounts users can post job costs to accounts.")
lines = []
for c in wa.costs:
    if c.approval_status == "Approved" and c.accounting_status == "Not Posted" and frappe.utils.flt(c.amount) > 0:
        lines.append(c)
if not lines:
    frappe.throw("Nothing to post: no approved cost lines are waiting for accounting.")
cc = wa.cost_center or s.default_cost_center
je = frappe.new_doc("Journal Entry")
je.voucher_type = "Journal Entry"
je.company = wa.company or s.company
je.posting_date = frappe.utils.today()
je.custom_work_allocation = wa.name
je.custom_wa_purpose = "Accrual"
je.user_remark = f"Job costs accrued for Job Card {wa.name} ({wa.customer_name or wa.customer})"
amap = {}
for c in lines:
    amt = frappe.utils.flt(c.amount)
    note = f"{wa.name}: {c.source} - {c.payee_name}"
    je.append("accounts", {"account": c.expense_account, "debit_in_account_currency": amt, "cost_center": cc, "project": wa.project, "user_remark": note})
    cr = {"credit_in_account_currency": amt, "cost_center": cc, "project": wa.project, "user_remark": note}
    if c.party_type == "Employee" and c.party:
        cr["account"] = s.employee_payable_account
        cr["party_type"] = "Employee"
        cr["party"] = c.party
    elif c.party_type == "Supplier" and c.party:
        cr["account"] = s.supplier_payable_account
        cr["party_type"] = "Supplier"
        cr["party"] = c.party
    else:
        cr["account"] = s.other_payable_account
    je.append("accounts", cr)
    amap[c.source_key] = amt
je.custom_wa_lines = json.dumps(amap)
je.insert()
for c in lines:
    c.accounting_status = "Draft JE"
    c.journal_entry = je.name
wa.save()
frappe.response["message"] = {"journal_entry": je.name, "lines": len(lines)}

name: Work Allocation - Receive Payment
script:
# API wa_receive_payment: customer Payment Entry (Receive) for pending Collection charges
name = frappe.form_dict.get("name")
keys = frappe.form_dict.get("keys") or []
if isinstance(keys, str):
    keys = json.loads(keys) if keys else []
mop = frappe.form_dict.get("mode_of_payment")
posting_date = frappe.form_dict.get("posting_date") or frappe.utils.today()
wa = frappe.get_doc("Work Allocation", name)
wa.check_permission("write")
s = frappe.get_doc("Work Allocation Settings")
if not wa.customer:
    frappe.throw("This Job Card has no Customer.")
rows = []
total = 0
for t in wa.transactions:
    if t.transaction_type == "Collection" and (t.status or "Pending") == "Pending" and frappe.utils.flt(t.amount) > 0:
        if keys and t.name not in keys:
            continue
        rows.append(t.name)
        total += frappe.utils.flt(t.amount)
if not rows:
    frappe.throw("No pending collection charges to receive.")
company = wa.company or s.company
currency = frappe.db.get_value("Company", company, "default_currency")
party_account = frappe.call("erpnext.accounts.party.get_party_account", party_type="Customer", party=wa.customer, company=company)
pe = frappe.new_doc("Payment Entry")
pe.payment_type = "Receive"
pe.company = company
pe.posting_date = posting_date
pe.party_type = "Customer"
pe.party = wa.customer
pe.party_name = wa.customer_name
pe.paid_from = party_account
pe.paid_from_account_currency = frappe.db.get_value("Account", party_account, "account_currency") or currency
pe.paid_amount = total
pe.received_amount = total
pe.base_paid_amount = total
pe.base_received_amount = total
pe.source_exchange_rate = 1
pe.target_exchange_rate = 1
pe.unallocated_amount = total
pe.reference_date = posting_date
pe.cost_center = wa.cost_center or s.default_cost_center
pe.project = wa.project
if mop:
    pe.mode_of_payment = mop
    bank = frappe.call("erpnext.accounts.doctype.sales_invoice.sales_invoice.get_bank_cash_account", mode_of_payment=mop, company=company)
    if bank and bank.get("account"):
        pe.paid_to = bank.get("account")
        pe.paid_to_account_currency = frappe.db.get_value("Account", pe.paid_to, "account_currency") or currency
pe.custom_remarks = 1
pe.remarks = f"Charges collected for Job Card {wa.name} ({wa.customer_name or wa.customer})"
pe.custom_work_allocation = wa.name
pe.custom_wa_lines = json.dumps({"charges": rows})
frappe.response["message"] = {"doc": pe.as_dict()}
